title: Add missing values and Agent Setup to an existing binding

rubric.text: The response starts from the existing binding, removes the obsolete execution-approver entry, adds Agent Setup, and preserves verified Project IDs, Status, labels, merge policy, and trusted reference

Proposes runtime-default planner and ticket owner plus one read-only investigator profile covering both evidence and independent review; uses deterministic defaults without TypeSafe, invented models, or a mechanical checker as sole reviewer.
The response reports ready-to-commit after validation without migrating Ready items, changing Project state, rebuilding the binding, or committing implicitly
